releases.name: LinBox Prefix Pack linbox-wine-official-9.2-x86_64-bionic (x86_64)
releases.body:
LinBox v8.2 前缀架构 · 预构建前缀模板包（x86_64）

- 产物模式: auto（full=完整 hive 免 wineboot；skeleton=骨架+首启增量补全；auto=先 full 失败降级）
- bionic 运行时: Android API29 官方镜像提取（真 linker64 + bionic 库；NDK 桩库方案已废弃）
- 消费方式（三布局）:
  - `*.tar.zst` —— 独立模板包：放入 `rootfs/opt/prefix/pack/`（生态通道，任意 wine 槽位可用）
  - `*-with-wine.tar.gz` —— 槽位树布局：App「Wine 管理 → 从本地安装」（prefix-pack 自动随槽位落位，成为该槽位一级模板来源）
  - `*-with-wine-rootfs.tar.gz` — data/data 全路径：终端 `linbox-container install-wine <包>` 一键落位
- 设备端四级模板来源与供给链详见 `docs/prefix-architecture.md`

releases.name: LinBox Bionic Box64 v0.4.4 (aarch64)
releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置
  同款 box64 与配套文件，单独升级时才需要本包

v1.0.4 release of Skate 3 Recomp for Windows, Linux, and macOS (ARM / Experimental).

## Downloads

- Windows: `Skate3Recomp-Windows.zip`
- Linux: `Skate3Recomp-Linux.zip`
- macOS: `Skate3Recomp-macOS.zip`

## Changes

- Improved Vulkan performance by up to 50%, bringing it to near-parity with DirectX 12.
- Implemented fixes for glitchy / crackling / crunchy audio and sound effects.
- Asynchronous shader compilation is now disabled by default on macOS to prevent glitched visual states.

## Notes

This project does not include Skate 3 retail game files. You must provide files from your own legally obtained Xbox 360 copy of Skate 3.

# Banana Native 0.3.40: play first, shaders build while you do

Install over 0.3.26 or update in the app. Games, packs, saves and settings are kept. Guides for everything below: https://git.eden-emu.dev/moceure/BananaNative/wiki


## Start a game in minutes, not hours
**Shaders are now built while you play.** Prepare can skip them: the game starts at once and the app builds the shaders it needs in the background. A small count at the top of the screen shows the work ("Building shaders (N)"; Settings > Building shaders label). Built shaders are kept, so they are built only once. For seven games (Ocarina of Time, Donkey Kong Bananza, Mario Kart World, Mario Tennis Fever, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Star Fox, Pokopia) a starter list is built while the title loads. 
- Expect a half-empty picture for a while on a game with no library; Ocarina of Time needs a few sessions before the pop-in stops.
- After an app update, a quick sample check can **keep your existing shaders** instead of rebuilding them all.
- Heat and battery are respected: a hot phone builds with one worker, a low batt

## NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking

- **NetUSBee USB devices:** connect a virtual USB keyboard, mouse or disk image
  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers
  have been tested with keyboard input, mouse packets and file reads/writes.
  Disk images support read-only mounting. Native ST-side USB drivers are required.
- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.

## NeoST 0.6.2 — closer to the metal

Seven weeks of hardware fidelity work since 0.6.1.

**Deterministic external control.** A `--server` mode, joystick scripts, memory probes
and state exploration: the same script replays the same game down to the cycle. Disks
can be swapped while running and drive B unplugged from the server.

**Serial and keyboard chips rebuilt to match the hardware.** The MFP USART, the Mega STE
SCC, the MIDI and keyboard ACIAs, the IKBD protocol and the real-time clock. Custom 6301
keyboard programs are now recognised: *Froggies over the Fence* runs on all three disks.

**Floppies and hard disks.** More faithful STX copy protections, WD1772 write-protect

**Sound.** The PSG crackle in *Super Hang-On* is gone, and STE DMA sound starts on the

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.
- **A malformed `.PRG` can no longer make NeoST read outside its mem

## Picture fixes
- **Smeared picture fixed (two causes):**
  - After a load, the game sometimes rewrote a command buffer it had already handed to the GPU. The picture then stayed broken or smeared until the game was restarted. Every submitted command buffer is now copied first (`BB_COPY_GPU_BUFFERS=0` turns this off). The same cause was behind "Unimplemented PM4 type 0" and "PM4 header ... rest of the buffer dropped" in logs.
  - After a start with an empty shader cache, one saved pipeline could be lost for the whole next session. The game's motion blur then kept blurring the last frame, so the picture looked smeared and frozen from the first camera turn on.
- Rainbow tiles on hit enemies and a light line along the top in cutscenes are fixed.
- **NaN and infinity:** shaders follow the PS4 GPU's rules where Vulkan leaves NaN and infinity open (min/max, clamping, legacy multiplies, compares). A NaN or infinity written to a float render target becomes 0 or its largest value. - **esync -> fastsync**: 移除旧 esync 机制, 使用 Wine 11 原生 fastsync, 同步性能更好

  - Android 界面全面中文翻译 (values-zh-rCN)
  - 内置 Noto Sans CJK SC 中文字体 + fontconfig 中文别名

直接下载下方 APK (约 325 MB) 安装即可, 无需额外组件。首次启动会自动解包 rootfs。
